title: How RL changes capabilities
summary: Studying how RL changes a model’s capabilities and whether imagined practice helps newly learned skills transfer and persist.
question: When does RL turn experience into a new, reusable skill, and can imagined practice help it transfer and persist?
abstract: I’m investigating how RL changes a small language model’s capabilities: whether it makes existing solutions more reliable, teaches new rules, or enables new combinations of skills.

The plan is to compare learning from real interaction, replaying the same experience, and practicing with a learned model of the environment. I’ll test whether newly learned skills transfer to unfamiliar tasks and survive further training.
Across training checkpoints, I’ll use causal interventions to investigate which internal changes explain gains in capability, transfer, or retention.
